description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseCalculatedFieldState' which implements logic for managing calculated field states, including argument management, readiness checks, size validation, and result serialization within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: BaseCalculatedFieldState
classes.description: An abstract class managing the state of calculated fields, including argument handling, readiness, size checks, and serialization.

methods.name: setCtx
methods.description: Sets the calculation context and actor reference, updates required arguments and readiness status.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization method, currently empty, intended for subclasses.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates argument entries with new values, checks argument size, and returns updated arguments.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing argument entry with a new one.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the state, clearing arguments and resetting size limit flag.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if the current state is ready based on arguments.

methods.name: checkStateSize
methods.description: Checks if the serialized size exceeds the maximum allowed, clears arguments if so.

methods.name: validateNewEntry
methods.description: Placeholder for validating new argument entries.

methods.name: toResultNode
methods.description: Converts argument values to a JSON node, including timestamp if applicable.

methods.name: getLatestTimestamp
methods.description: Calculates the latest timestamp from argument entries.

methods.name: checkReadiness
methods.description: Checks if all required arguments are present and non-empty, returns readiness status.

methods.name: getArgumentsJson
methods.description: Serializes arguments to JSON, filtering out empty entries.
